lead_raw_text:
The structure of ZrZnSe₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a unit cell containing 10 atoms across 5 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Zn centers coordinated by 5 Se neighbors, Zr centers with 8 neighbors (4 Se and 4 Zn), and Se environments involving 6 or 7 neighbors, including Se–Zn and Se–Zr contacts. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Zn 5-vertex and Se 6-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing among Se 7-vertex polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites.
